preserved_regions.observed: Vivid cobalt blue versus orange complementary system, upper-left shadows and opaque landscape 3:2 canvas remain.
All five strings remain exact and legible; hierarchy and centered grouping stay materially similar.
Bulky ends, thin lateral stretch necks and soft central belly retained; visible pulling action stays clear.

changed_regions.observed: Lower ㄹ of 말, ㅇ of 랑 and 중 separate into whole glyphs rather than melt into sculpture; title enlarges slightly and more regular syllable spacing appears.
Black eyes and smiling mouth removed, the center becomes plain clay.
Endpoints lower slightly under title words, with independent outlines instead of absorbing glyph anatomy.

regressed_regions.observed: Literal title-to-bridge fusion disappears; relation is now adjacency of words to separate anchor pads, slightly less literal force transfer but necessary to protect Hangul.
Scratch grain is a little more uniform and broad than parent. No chrome or sharp plastic reflection introduced.

selection_judgment: Repair-1 improves actual normal Hangul and removes added mascot while retaining all copy, clay3D, complementary palette and horizontal stretching. Its residual endpoint spacing and grain are preferable to initial merged title anatomy.
